notes: family: auction-money. No VP: after the game-ending Build Houses phase, each player counts cities they can power; most wins. Player other than the one who triggered the end can win. Rulebook text read via RulesPal transcription, not the original PDF (needsReview). Full tie after money has no further tiebreak stated. Two-player Trust opponent cannot win.

endCondition.description: Game ends right after Build Houses when any player has connected the city count set by player count (2p vs Trust 18, 3-4p 17, 5p 15, 6p 14 per rulebook table).
